 3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  This is the time set aside for members of the public to address the City Council on
  items of interest that are not on the Agenda, but are within the subject matter
  jurisdiction of the San Gabriel City Council. Pursuant to the Brown Act, the City
  Council cannot answer any questions or take any action until such time as the
  matter may appear as an item on a future agenda.

  In an effort to provide everyone with an opportunity to speak tonight, please be
  aware that all public comments will be limited to a maximum of three minutes. I
  will give you a 30-second warning as you approach the end of your time. As a
  reminder, please be respectful of all speakers regardless of the position they take
  on any items.

  If you wish to address the City Council, please complete a speaker’s request card
  and hand it to me before the start of the meeting. When speaking, please state
  your NAME for the record.

 4. CONSENT CALENDAR

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – April 2, 2019  2
   All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  This is the presentation of the “Register of Demands and Warrants” for the
  payment of City expenditures.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  B. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of March 19, 2019.
  2. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of March 19, 2019.

  Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. DIGITAL COPY MACHINE LEASE PROPOSAL

  The San Gabriel Police Department entered into a three-year lease agreement
  in August 2014 with Canon Solutions America, Inc. for two of our current
  copiers. This lease agreement expired in August 2017 and the Police
  Department has been on a month-to-month basis since that time. The primary
  and secondary copiers have performed adequately for the Police Department
  over the last five years and have become run-down due to a rigorous 24/7 work
  operation and now requires frequent servicing and maintenance. Within the
  past year, both copiers had 17 service calls for maintenance and repairs.
  Canon and the products identified in the report have been through the
  competitive bid process with the National IPA, Contract #CP-002-13.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Waive the formal competitive bidding procedure; and
  2. Authorize the Chief of Police to utilize the cooperative discount pricing; and
  end the existing lease or purchase the copiers; and

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – April 2, 2019  3
   3. Approve a five-year lease agreement with Canon Solutions America, Inc. for
  two new copiers (Black/white and color copiers) for the police station, and
  an additional color copier for the satellite station; and
  4. Authorize the new base lease/maintenance expenditure of $725 per month
  for a five-year lease agreement.

 5. PUBLIC HEARING

  A. SAN GABRIEL PLAZA MIXED-USE PROJECT: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT,
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT, REQUEST TO VACATE CITY STREETS, AND
  TENTATIVE TRACT MAP No. 80292; ADOPTION OF MITIGATED NEGATIVE
  DECLARATION AND MITIGATION MONITORING AND REPORTING
  PROGRAM (PLANNING CASE No. PL-16-162; 220 SOUTH SAN GABRIEL
  BOULEVARD)
  APPLICANT: SAN GABRIEL SQUARE LLC/EDWARD CHANG (MANAGER)
  This is a request for a Planned Development (PD), Development Agreement
  (DA), Request to Vacate City Streets, and Tentative Tract Map No. 80292 (TTM)
  to allow for the construction of a mixed-use project consisting of 163 residential
  condominium units and 34,835 square feet (SF) of retail and restaurant uses on
  an approximately 3.66-acre site generally located at 220 South San Gabriel
  Boulevard.

  These land use entitlements may be approved or denied by the City Council.
  On March 11, the Planning Commission, who serves as the recommending
  body, considered the proposed project and recommended City Council
  adoption of the relevant environmental documentation and approval of the
  proposed project by a vote of 4-0, as modified by the Commission. Should the
  project be approved by the City Council, the development would be subject to
  Design Review by the Design Review Commission before proceeding to
  Building Plan Check.
  Recommended Action:

  The action of the City Council may be to approve, approve with modifications,
  or deny the Planned Development, Development Agreement, Request to
  Vacate City Streets, and Tentative Tract Map. Staff recommends that the City
  Council:

  1. Conduct the public hearing and discuss the proposed Ordinance No. 651;
  and
  2. Motion to waive full reading and introduce the attached Ordinance by title
  only. The City Clerk will read aloud the full title of the Ordinance; and

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – April 2, 2019  4
   3. Motion to approve the First Reading of the Ordinance No. 651 and to waive
  future reading of the Ordinance; and
  4. Schedule the Second Reading and adoption of the Ordinance for the next
  regular Council meeting. The Second Reading will require a majority vote of
  the total membership of the Council.

 6. NEW BUSINESS

  A. UPDATE ON SEWER SYSTEM

  Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of

  report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

 10. CLOSED SESSION – None.

 11. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, April 16, 2019 at

  California. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.
